root.name: Catalan Opening: Open Defense
root.moves: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. g3 d5 4. Bg2 dxc4

overview: Black takes on c4 and White regains the pawn with Qa4+ or Nf3 and Qc2/Ne5, or by simply building pressure first. White keeps the long-diagonal bishop on g2 and a queenside initiative; Black tries to hold the pawn with ...b5 or gives it back for easy development and ...c5. The game is a slow positional squeeze rather than an attack.

white_ideas.idea: Regain c4 with Qc2 or Qa4+ and keep the Bg2 diagonal pressure on b7
Queenside pressure with Rd1, Nc3, Ne5 and a lead in development

black_ideas.idea: Hold the pawn with ...b5 and ...Bb7, or return it for ...c5
Develop ...Be7, ...O-O, ...a6 and neutralise the bishop with ...Bb7

typical_structures.structure: White d4 only against Black e6; the c-file and long diagonal are open

character.notes: Positional pressure with a clear structure; neither side is forced into sharp play.

gambit.notes: White regains the c4 pawn by force or Black returns it; not a real gambit.

soundness.notes: Sound; main line of the Catalan.

structure.notes: Black's c-pawn is gone and White has d4; semi-open c-file, pieces on the long diagonal; tag cautiously as flexible.

approach.notes: A standard main-line Catalan; the g3/Bg2 set-up against ...d5, not against everything.

level.notes: Needs knowledge of the regaining lines and of the Catalan pressure.

sublines_that_differ.name: 5.Nf3 c5 6.O-O Nc6
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. d4 Nf6 2. c4 e6 3. g3 d5 4. Bg2 dxc4 5. Nf3 c5 6. O-O Nc6
sublines_that_differ.how: Black counterattacks in the centre; more open play.

character.reason: Positional pressure, no forcing attack, but less solid than the Closed lines.

gambit.reason: The pawn on c4 returns by force.

soundness.reason: Main line of a respected opening.

structure.reason: Centre is fluid with c-pawn exchanged; could be read as open.

approach.reason: A main-line system played by strong players.

level.reason: Some theory and positional understanding; not forcing theory.

plans.reason: Bg2 diagonal and queenside pressure define the line.
